overview_description.description: At https://algotest.in/, we are continuously building tools to help retail traders make better decisions for their investments. Our first product is a free options backtester for India. Our experience in the markets spans geographies and market segments - strategies we've worked on range from electronic options market-making in some of the deepest options markets in the world (CBOE, AMEX, PHLX, ARCA, ISE), to backtested factor-based market-taking strategies in NSE's F&O segment. Members of our team have manually entered into trades where the hold time was as large as 6+ months, as well as written algos where the average hold time has been 10 seconds or less. We invite you to leverage our extensive experience and evaluate your trading strategies for free. Sign up Now at AlgoTest.in!
